LESSON: NOAH AND HIS SONS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.4: Noah and his sons

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Noah and his sons
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is the story of Noah still relevant in today’s society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly
2. respect the elderly at home, church and in the community

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: respect the elderly at home, church and in the community

Teach
• Today’s focus: respect the elderly at home, church and in the community.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “respect the elderly at home, church and in the community” using a school example.
• Model B for “respect the elderly at home, church and in the community” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "respect the elderly at home, church and in the community" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly
• Model 2: respect the elderly at home, church and in the community

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly
2. Practise: respect the elderly at home, church and in the community

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Noah and his sons.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the story of Noah still relevant in today’s society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly
• respect the elderly at home, church and in the community

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
